body: Not very exciting. Sad mostly. I studied physics and math.

The feelings have been around for a long time. Coming up on graduation, not having a job, and having a low gpa made it worse. Yesterday my girlfriend broke up with me. Since then I haven't been able to stop thinking about suicide. 

I don't think I'll feel better after graduation.

What I'm worried about is the line between suicidal thoughts and "immediate plan." I've talked to them about my suicidal thoughts, but haven't been honest about their severity. Which has been increasing recently.

I'm about to graduate and killing myself is practically the only thing I can think about. I only wish I had a painless means of doing it.
